outcome: An exchange happens entirely or not at all: if any part cannot be completed on resolution, nothing is exchanged.
Exchanging control of two permanents with different controllers swaps their controllers simultaneously; with the same controller it does nothing.
Each player gains or loses life to equal the other's previous total, modified by replacement effects and limited by can't-gain or can't-lose-life effects.
Cards in two zones are exchanged only if all are owned by the same player, and the exchange works even when one zone is empty.
An exchanged card that was attached to an object stops being attached and the other card becomes attached to it.
Exchanging two zones where one is empty still moves the cards of the other.
Two numerical values swap; life totals change by gain or loss, and power or toughness is set by a continuous effect to the other value.
The rules text of each of two creatures becomes the previous text of the other.
note: One card only; text-changing effects are not captured as a continuous-record field.
